verdict.rationale: Kick documents role-based access control for workspace collaborators (kick-docs-11), a dedicated accountant-facing page/workflow (kick-docs-3), period locking so accountants can finalize books that even the owner can't alter (kick-supp-locks), a full audit trail of all changes (kick-supp-audit-trail), and a tax package built for handoff to accountants/preparers (kick-docs-9, kick-docs-20) — together covering invite-and-collaborate-with-scoped-access for external bookkeepers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the invite flow UI and enumerated role types/permission granularity (e.g., what an 'accountant' role can vs cannot do beyond generic RBAC mention).
